Question 2
?

The velocity vector v=⟨u,v⟩ of a particle P at time t is given by v=⟨ln⁡(3t+2),sin⁡(2t+5)⟩,t>0. Calculate the acceleration vector a.

a
a=⟨33t+2,−cos⁡(2t+5)⟩
b
a=⟨13t+2,2cos⁡(2t+5)⟩
c
a=⟨33t+2,−2cos⁡(2t+5)⟩
d
a=⟨33t+2,2cos⁡(2t+5)⟩
e
a=⟨13t+2,cos⁡(2t+5)⟩
Submit
